seo.title: Tzu-Ling Hung | Percussionist & Composer
seo.description: Tzu-Ling Hung is a percussionist, chamber musician, and composer working across contemporary music, new work, and cross-disciplinary performance.

hero.image_alt: Abstract sound-art materials with water, stones, glass bowls, and xylophone wood
hero.tagline: Percussion, sound, and theatrical performance shaped by close listening and new possibility.

practice.statement: From solo percussion to staged multimedia work, Tzu-Ling treats performance as a place for curiosity, precision, and exchange.

about.heading: Expanding percussion through new music, collaboration, and performance.
paragraphs: Tzu-Ling Hung is a solo percussionist, chamber musician, and composer based in Denton, Texas, and Pingtung, Taiwan. A versatile artist spanning classical and contemporary music, Hung is drawn to the repertoire's openness to experimentation and its search for new possibilities. Her artistic practice focuses on expanding underrepresented voices, exploring theatrical elements in performance, and using music to translate her personal background into compelling stories.

As a soloist, Hung won first prize in the 2024 American Soloist International Music Competition, and was a semi-finalist in both the International Marimba Competition at Chapman University and the International Percussion Competition at Northwestern University.

Equally active as a chamber musician, Hung has extensive experience in both percussion duos and ensembles. While performing with the UNT Percussion Ensemble, she won the 2025 PAS International Percussion Ensemble Competition, leading to a showcase concert in Indianapolis. While she deeply champions traditional percussion repertoire, her expertise extends globally to include Brazilian Samba-Bateria, Maracatu, Afro-Cuban, and Balinese Gamelan.

Hung is deeply dedicated to new music and cross-disciplinary collaborations with visual design artists. Her 2025 multimedia performance, tREeAL, explored the spectrum of direct acoustic interaction, pure electronic software-based effects, and the hybrid spaces between them. Her latest project, HSS, features collaborations with David Stout and Colin Stokes. Under the guidance of David Dzubay and Elizabeth McNutt, Hung's recent new music repertoire includes works by George Crumb, Louis Andriessen, and Pamela Z. She also actively commissions new pieces, most recently collaborating with composer Sungji Hong on the 2026 vibraphone solo, Ring Ring.

As a composer, Hung studied with Professor Chia-Lin Pan at the University of Taipei. Her works draw inspiration from a delicate observation of her surroundings, collecting the sounds and perceptions of daily life. Her recent compositions include Pencil & Paper for percussion quartet (2024), Ocean for marimba solo (2021), and Stop, following for snare drum duo (2020).

Hung earned her Bachelor of Fine Arts in percussion performance from the University of Taipei under Professor Ya-Chi Cheng, and holds a Master of Music and a Performer Diploma from the Indiana University Jacobs School of Music, where she studied with Kevin Bobo, Joseph Gramley, John Tafoya, and Joseph Galvin. Currently, Hung is completing her Doctor of Musical Arts at the University of North Texas, where she also serves as a Teaching Fellow under the mentorship of Mark Ford, Dave Hall, and Paul Rennick.

about.heading: 以新音樂、跨域合作與舞台實踐拓展打擊樂的可能。
paragraphs: 旅美打擊樂演奏家、室內樂演奏家與作曲家洪梓菱，兼具古典與現代音樂的演奏實力。其深受當代音樂中那份勇於實驗、不斷探索新可能性的特質所吸引，藝術實踐專注於發掘與研究非主流及新興作品、探索劇場元素如何深化舞台體驗，並致力將個人的成長背景與生活觀察融入音樂，轉化為深刻動人的舞台演出。

洪梓菱現為美國北德州大學（University of North Texas）打擊樂演奏博士候選人，並兼任該校助教（Teaching Fellow），師事 Mark Ford、Paul Rennick、Dave Hall、Ed Smith、Stockton Helbing、Jose Aponte、Sriji Poovalur。在此之前，她於台北市立大學取得學士學位，師事鄭雅琪教授；隨後赴美國印第安那大學積可斯音樂學院（Indiana University Jacobs School of Music）深造，師事 Kevin Bobo、Joseph Gramley、John Tafoya、Joseph Galvin，取得打擊樂演奏碩士學位與演奏家文憑。於該校就讀期間，她的碩士畢業音樂會更榮獲全體評委一致推薦，獲頒演奏榮譽證書（Performer's Certificate）。
作為獨奏家，洪梓菱在國際賽事中屢獲佳績，曾榮獲 2024 年美國獨奏家國際音樂大賽（American Soloist International Music Competition）首獎，並曾入圍查普曼大學（Chapman University）國際馬林巴木琴大賽、西北大學（Northwestern University）國際打擊樂大賽之準決賽。

在室內樂領域，洪梓菱亦累積了豐富且多元的二重奏與打擊樂團經驗。隨北德州大學打擊樂團（UNT Percussion Ensemble）演出期間，她與團員共同贏得 2025 年國際打擊樂藝術協會（PAS）國際打擊樂團大賽優勝，並受邀至印第安納波利斯（Indianapolis）舉辦的 IPEC 專場音樂會中登台演出。在打擊樂團的範疇中，洪梓菱不僅深耕傳統打擊樂經典曲目，其演奏版圖更廣及世界音樂，涵蓋巴西森巴（Samba-Bateria）、馬拉卡圖（Maracatu）、非洲古巴拉丁樂（Afro-Cuban）以及峇里島甘美朗（Balinese Gamelan）等多元傳統。

除了深厚的古典與當代打擊樂曲目，洪梓菱亦將觸角延伸至多元跨界的合作企劃。她於 2025 年推出的多媒體跨界演出《tREeAL》，即探討了傳統打擊樂器的實體原音、純電子軟體特效，以及兩者之間的混合空間。其最新合作計畫《HSS》則與 David Stout 和 Colin Stokes 共同攜手。在 David Dzubay 與 Elizabeth McNutt 的指導下，她近期演出的現代室內樂曲目涵蓋了 George Crumb、Louis Andriessen 及 Pamela Z 等當代名家的作品。同時，她也積極與作曲家合作並委託創作，近期（2026 年）便與作曲家 Sungji Hong 合作，發表了鐵琴獨奏委託創作《Ring Ring》。
在作曲方面，洪梓菱曾於台北市立大學師從潘家琳教授。她的創作靈感多源自對周遭環境的細膩觀察，習慣將日常生活中收集到的聲音與感知化為音符。其近期的代表作品包括打擊樂四重奏《Pencil & Paper》（2024）、馬林巴木琴獨奏《Ocean》（2021），以及小鼓二重奏《Stop, following》（2020）。
